title: Lanternfall 1.0
notes: Lanternfall 1.0: 21 worlds, each with its own twist, foe and boss, down to the Moth Queen at the Hollow Moon.
12 lanterns, 53 boons, camp upgrades, lantern mastery, a rank road to level 100 and Prestige up to X.
Endless now starts in a random world you've unlocked; each world lasts 5 waves and ends with its boss.
The tutorial has its own card on the world list, so you can play it again any time.
The Season 1 pass and the Hollow Harvest event pass both end November 1.
